## Lil Gwapz — selected direction (2026-10-08)

Founder selected Option 3, The Playground, for `/lil-gwapz`. Use a deep purple background, glossy character cutouts, Gwap Green #13DD13 calls to action, Orange/Red/Purple mood accents, and a safe-area-aware bottom navigation. Retain search and Male/Female/All filters from Option 2. Mood categories organize existing reactions; they do not rename canonical IDs or artwork. Reuse existing approved sprite atlases. Downloads remain individual PNG exports with native share support; no universal keyboard installation or complete-pack ZIP promise. Hosted 21st generation and retrieval were skipped because the Founder opted to skip login.
